title: Do They Expect Us to Believe This?
description:
The claim that Clinton and Obama deported more people than Trump is misleading and politically stupid.

We breakdown why those numbers rely on border turnarounds, definitional tricks, and inflated stats, while Trump actually reduced crossings and increased effective removals.

If you support border enforcement, this is the argument you shouldn’t be making.
